subject: Civic Education
lesson: Identifies the public services: Teacher approach: Watch a 3-minute video on Pradeshiya Sabha...
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the common features related to public services.
the_entrance: Engage students with a question on local community needs. (5 mins)
post_activity: Record public services observed at home.
selected_activity: Watch a 3-minute video on Pradeshiya Sabha meetings, then conduct group debate.
selected_activity_title: Teacher approach: Watch a 3-minute video on Pradeshiya Sabha meetings, then conduct group debate.

activity_options.title: Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Democratic Governance
activity_options.description: Students use mock local council / pradeshiya sabha session to explore 'Identifies the public services.'. Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
activity_options.student_action_summary: Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
activity_options.teacher_facilitation_summary: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
activity_options.student_grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
activity_options.expected_student_output: A short role-based civic decision and its reasons.
activity_options.creative_assessment_preview: Students state one role responsibility and explain how it supported the decision.
activity_options.low_resource_alternative: Use spoken prompts and notebook pages if printed or display materials are unavailable.
learning_outcomes_addressed: Explains the common features related to public services.
Explains the need of public services.
Presents views appreciating the importance of public services of the times.
Investigates information on the beginning and progress of public services.

activity_options.title: Evidence-Based Case Dilemma Audit: Democratic Governance
activity_options.description: Teams analyze a teacher-presented real-world civic dilemma reflecting 'Identifies the public services.'. They investigate institutional duties versus citizen responsibilities.
activity_options.student_action_summary: Discuss the scenario, identify civic duties, and record or report supporting evidence. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
